verdict: Yes, with a quality edge. Wise Life pitched yoga and wellness accessories on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from four sharks. Yoga is a daily habit for millions of Indians, but cheap mats and blocks flood marketplaces, so compete on materials such as natural rubber, cork and jute.
angle: Yoga mats, blocks, straps and meditation cushions are bought by studios, teachers and home practitioners. Eco-friendly materials command higher prices, and teachers influence what their students buy. International Yoga Day and New Year are peak seasons.
